## Analyzers (1)

### Jupyter_Run_Notebook_Analyzer `v1.0`
Execute a parameterized notebook in Jupyter

- **Author:** Alexandre Demeyer
- **License:** AGPL-V3
- **Data Types:** `domain`, `hostname`, `ip`, `url`, `fqdn`, `uri_path`, `user-agent`, `hash`, `mail`, `mail_subject`, `registry`, `regexp`, `other`, `filename`, `mail-subject`
- **Configuration:** [.upstream/cortex/analyzers/Jupyter/Jupyter_Run_Notebook_Analyzer.json](https://github.com/nusantara-self/strangebee-integrations/blob/main/.upstream/cortex/analyzers/Jupyter/Jupyter_Run_Notebook_Analyzer.json) ([raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nusantara-self/strangebee-integrations/refs/heads/main/.upstream/cortex/analyzers/Jupyter/Jupyter_Run_Notebook_Analyzer.json))
